name: YuE
abstract: YuE is M-A-P's open foundation model family for full-song music generation: from lyrics to a complete, structured song — vocals, accompaniment, and multi-minute coherence — released with weights and training recipe. It anchors the open end of the lyrics-to-song problem the way open code models anchored programming.
contributions: Generates complete songs — verse, chorus, vocals, and instrumental accompaniment — from lyrics, at multi-minute length with structural coherence.
Supports multiple languages and vocal styles, with in-context conditioning for style, melody, and voice.
Fully open release: model weights, inference stack, and recipe, making it the reference open lyrics-to-song system.
method: A dual-track token design models vocals and accompaniment jointly while keeping them separable.
Long-context audio tokenization sustains song-level structure instead of short clips.
Evaluation combines human preference studies with audio-quality and lyric-alignment measures against commercial systems.

metrics.name: Song-level quality
metrics.note: Tracked qualitatively via the paper's human preference and alignment studies.
